<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kurdish separatism in Iran|Kurdish–Iranian conflict]]
**[[Iran]]'s [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] (IRGC) strikes the [[headquarters]] of the [[Democratic Party of Iranian Kurdistan]] in [[Koy Sanjaq]], [[Kurdistan Region]], [[Iraq]], with four [[missile]]s, killing at least one person. The IRGC says that it "targeted terrorist groups" with missiles and [[unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/14/iran-rockets-hit-kurdish-party-hq-in-iraqs-erbil (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[France–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[English Channel migrant crossings (2018–present)|English Channel migrant crossings]]
***The [[United Kingdom]] and [[France]] sign a revised [[border control]] agreement to stop migrant boats from crossing the [[English Channel]] amid record numbers of migrants making the crossing. The agreement will increase the number of officers patrolling the French coast to 300 and have British [[Law enforcement in the United Kingdom|police officers]] work with their French counterparts in control rooms and on beaches. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-63615653 (BBC News)]
*[[Iran–European Union relations]]
**The [[European Union]] adds 30 Iranian entities including news channel [[Press TV]] and cloud computing service [[Abr Arvan]] to its sanctions blacklist. [https://taz.de/Iranische-Tarnfirmen-in-Deutschland/!5885984/ (Taz)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Istanbul bombing]]
**[[Ministry of Interior (Turkey)|Turkish interior minister]] [[Süleyman Soylu]] says that 46 people, including the person accused of planting the bomb, have been detained. Süleyman also accuses the [[Kurdistan Workers' Party]] of being behind the attack. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/14/turkish-police-arrest-suspect-in-istiklal-bombing (Al Jazeera)]
